measurement: Matched release cases. Flash includes the CRC footer, initialized data and padding. Static RAM and maximum compiler-reported stack frame match the baseline for every case.
scope: The F401 keyboard and context changes apply to product and capability builds. Register-family encoding replaces the previous product mnemonic decoder. Compact font metrics apply when proportional UI fonts are enabled.

classic_v3_isolated.method: Each change was linked alone against the same GCC baseline. The final link also changes code and data alignment.

cortex_m4.target: GCC F401 Classic V3 resident ELF on Unicorn Cortex-M4. Counts are executed guest instructions.
cortex_m4.hardware: Physical F401 unavailable. Hardware cycle counts were not measured.
cortex_m4.context_compatibility: Six 896-byte snapshots matched byte-for-byte. Each image restored the other image’s snapshots. Both rejected a corrupted magic without changing live state.
cortex_m4.keyboard_method: 40 Classic keys in plain, F and K states through the key handler. Compared the returned mnemonic position and all eight label bytes at descriptor return, or handler exit for bypassed keys.
cortex_m4.terminal_method: Executed asm 0000 with operands 1, Kx>=0 4, KП->X9 (M8), and + 2 3. The command result and calculator snapshot matched for each command.
cortex_m4.glyph_method: 181 codepoints and six fallbacks per face. Compared advances, bearings, dimensions, layout and bitmap bytes with each source atlas.

tests: Nine native F401 release cases and the pinned STM32duino Classic V3 release check passed CRC, ELF and budget checks.
All 14 native core configurations passed with ASan/UBSan. Packed contexts cover every four-nibble tuple, four alignments, short tails, invalid high bits and failed-save atomicity.
Both terminal profiles passed ASM/ISA/LASM/PUB comparisons across all 240 mnemonics. The F401 assembler preserved program memory when scratch was busy.
Legacy and F401 font formats each matched all 543 glyphs and 24845 pixels across three source atlases.
Keyboard scanning and handoff passed. Profile mappings and terminal key sequences passed for Mini, Classic and 40th.
The M61 Runner suite passed on the native, F401 and Mini host profiles, including input, timers, lookups and two asynchronous campaigns per profile.

f411_control.comparison: Byte-identical resident.bin before sealing in matched builds.
